title: Chinese astronomers record supernova SN 185
summary: Astronomers of the Han dynasty recorded a new star near Alpha Centauri that stayed visible for months. It is the earliest recorded supernova.
reason: The Han court kept careful records of celestial events, which were believed to carry omens for the state.
significance: It is the oldest known record of a supernova, now linked to the remnant RCW 86.
